name: Japan

system.type: Parallel: single-member districts plus proportional blocks
system.elects: 465 members of the House of Representatives

wildFacts.text: The LDP won 316 of 465 seats, the largest two-thirds majority by a single party in the postwar era.

notes: Snap election confirmed by two sources (IPU, CSIS). IPU: LDP won 315 seats; CSIS: 316 (an independent joined). Turnout 56.3% (PR ballot, 58,061,448 voters) per IPU. Other party totals (CRA 49, DPP 28, Sanseito 15, Team Mirai 11) and the 289/176 split not confirmed: omitted. Record early-voting claim is Wikipedia-only: dropped. Not compulsory (IDEA list).
